name: career-radar
description: A scheduled career radar that finds recent remote jobs, evaluates them against a user's resume, and highlights the best opportunities.

interface.longDescription: Career Radar searches for recent remote opportunities, validates that applications are still open, scores each job against the user's resume and preferences, and produces an evidence-based report without applying automatically.
defaultPrompt: Find new remote jobs matching my profile.
Evaluate recent jobs against my resume.
Set up a weekly career search.
